name: SRA_study
title: Study
description: A Study is a container for a sequencing investigation that may comprise multiple experiments. The Study has an overall goal, but is otherwise minimally defined in the SRA. A Study is composed of a descriptor, zero or more experiments, and zero or more analyses. The submitter may decorate the Study with web links and properties.

name: MIMICC_Experiment
title: MIMICC Experiment Submission
description: Schema for MIMICC sequencing-experiment metadata submission to ENA. Filtered from mimicc_sample_experiment.yaml down to the SRA-experiment-scoped slots (via scripts/dh_schema.py filter), with PLATFORM/INSTRUMENT added (absent from the source schema) and slot titles/names aligned to the mimicc-ena-submission-assistant app's webin-cli manifest contract (see that app's README "Experiment metadata schema"). Does not include sample metadata (covered by mimicc_sample_experiment.yaml) or the read-file/sample-pairing decision (covered by that app's own pairing table) — only the per-run sequencing/library metadata.

name: MIMICC_Sample
title: MIMICC Sample Submission
description: Schema for MIMICC sample metadata submission to ENA. Filtered from mimicc_sample_experiment.yaml down to the ERC000025/ENA.sample/ENA.project/MIMICC.custom -scoped slots (via scripts/dh_schema.py filter-data's SQL-WHERE-on-slot-metadata mechanism, applied to schema slots rather than export data: source IN ('ERC000025', 'MIMICC.custom', 'ENA.sample', 'ENA.project')). Covers ERC000025 sample metadata and MIMICC-specific culture and perturbation attributes. Does not include experiment/library metadata (see mimicc_experiment.yaml) or study metadata.
